nom: Beekman 1802 Golden Booster Amla Berry Vitamin C Brightening Serum

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-oily skin consistently report the serum absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, and helps even out their skin tone and dark spots.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who say most products are hard for their skin to tolerate, report no irritation and often a reduction in existing redness; the exception is one reviewer whose face turned red, burning, and splotchy, despite years of using other vitamin C serums without issue.
segments.normal: The two reviewers who describe their skin as normal or average, neither oily nor dry, both report a visibly brighter, more even complexion within days.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s report a brighter, more radiant look and softer fine lines; one long-term reviewer in her 70s with previously very dry, thin, flaky skin says the line resolved her constant dryness, though her age spots are still a work in progress.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report their fine lines and wrinkles appear softer with continued use, alongside the brightening effect.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as non-drying, with several specifically noting it does not dehydrate skin the way other vitamin C products have for them, and one reviewer in her 70s reports it resolved months of constant dryness, thinness, and flaking on her face.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers specifically credit the serum with calming persistent redness, including cheeks that used to embarrass them, with results appearing within days; against that, two reviewers report the opposite reaction, with their skin turning red, burning, and in one case developing a splotchy rash badly enough that they had to wash it off immediately.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visibly fading dark spots, sun spots, or post-acne marks, and a brighter, more even skin tone, often within two to four weeks; a consistent minority, however, report no brightening effect at all even after finishing the entire bottle, and one long-term user says her age spots have not yet budged.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin consistently report the serum does not cause new breakouts or clog pores, and several credit it with fading acne scars and post-acne marks.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way, just a few drops
Attractive packaging with a quality dropper

extraits.texte: I will start this review by saying I do have sensitive skin. However, I have used a vitamin C serum for years and I have never experienced the redness, burning, and splotchy rash that this serum left me with.

I got this product in a sample bag. Unfortunately, this product made my skin burn so bad! I can't really say I have sensitive skin, nothing I've ever applied before has made me have a reaction but this burn soo bad, my cheeks were super red and I couldnt continue, I had to wash it off. It might be a fine product, just wasnt for me
Did not do anything for me. My skin stayed the same, didn't get worse or better. I used the whole bottle.

I usually never comment on products but felt I had to for this one since it worked so so great for me and I was pretty surprised to read any negative comments. My skin looked brighter in just a few days, my complexion looks healthier, people keep asking me what is my beauty routine. I algo use their collagen booster and both products work great together, I totally recommend. For reference, I'm 36 yrs old and my skin is normal

I have pretty average skin. Not oily not dry, get occasional breakouts but not regularly. I was dealing with skin tone changes/red areas/under eye darkness when I moved to a new city with bad water and after a challenging year with my health. My skin was getting red spots and was looking very dull especially around my eyes. I used this nightly for a couple weeks and it changed my skin completely! My skin looks more even and much brighter. I usually don't like to spend over $20-$25 on skincare, I'm cheap, but this is so worth it. And it's a clean product which I love. I HIGHLY recommend. Affordable compared to other similar products and you don't need much. I still have about half the product left even after using it so much at first, and now that I have reached a point with my skin that I'm happy with, it's more maintenance and I use it twice a week or so. I wish I had taken before and after because I notice such a big difference in brightness and even tone. Especially brighter under my eyes- which is huge since I have health issues that impact my sleep, which impact the darkness under my eyes. Couldn't be happier. I will DEFINITELY be buying this again.

extraits.titre: A thrilling interim report update to follow
extraits.texte: WDC age 71 In the morning I use the Amla Berry booster with the Milk Drops probiotic ceramide serum as a hydrating base and the Bloom Cream mixed with the Boost. At night I use the Dream Booster blended with the Bloom Cream over my clean and hydrated (with Milk Drops serum} face. My skin was very dry, thin and flaky. Most OTC creams are not hydrating enough and have not helped at all with the flakiness on my forehead and sides of the face. So I am thrilled to find the Beekman 1802 products which are gentle and very effective. I stared using your hand creams in the fall, and the face products in early December. Now, at the New Year, after one of the coldest winters in decades here in the Southern Tier of New York, I no longer experience a constant dryness or loss of hydration or elasticity. There is a lovely glow as well. I still have age spots, so I will let you know if those diminish over time. Thank you all and give a few skritches behind the ears to those fabulous kids you are raising!

Beekman recommended me this product for redness, and I bought it on impulse for Black Friday. I've been using it for almost 3 weeks now, and the results are amazing. Within a few days, I saw a change in how red my skin naturally was. My cheeks were particularly sensitive spots for turning red, which used to embarrass me, but now the redness is toned down and goes away quickly if provoked. I also feel like my skin looks more bright since using this booster. Definitely recommend it to anyone struggling with excessive redness!
